mechanism: knockdown of Orai1 and/or STIM1 lowered proliferation, metabolism, migration and invasion in two gastric cancer lines, and every one of those effects was reversed by MACC1 overexpression; the title states the direction (elevated Orai1 and STIM1 expressions upregulate MACC1 expression)
sentence: In summary, the composite molecules of SOCE suggest a poor prognosis for GC by promoting tumor cell proliferation, metabolism, migration, and invasion by targeting MACC1.
justification: A transcriptional target downstream of both anchors at once, placed by a rescue experiment rather than by correlation: MACC1 overexpression restores what the loss of SOCE took away. It gives the ORAI1/STIM1 arm a named effector in epithelial tumour biology.

mechanism: same rescue experiment; STIM1 knockdown alone reproduced the phenotype and MACC1 overexpression reversed it
sentence: In summary, the composite molecules of SOCE suggest a poor prognosis for GC by promoting tumor cell proliferation, metabolism, migration, and invasion by targeting MACC1.
justification: The STIM1 side of the same effector link, kept separate because the paper tested the two anchors separately as well as together.

mechanism: cardiomyocyte-specific inducible Orai1 knockout: chronic angiotensin-II raised Stim1 and Orai3 transcripts in control hearts and not at all in Orai1CM-KO hearts, so the stress-evoked induction of the sensor needs the channel
sentence: We observed that the upregulation of Orai3 and Stim1 expression evoked by neurohumoral stress via chronic AngII treatment depends completely on the expression of Orai1.
justification: The anchors regulate each other's abundance, and in the direction the map had least evidence for: the pore subunit controls the induction of the sensor under stress. It complements the opposite arm recorded from PMC11730744 (STIM1 driving ORAI1 degradation).

mechanism: same experiment; the angiotensin-II-evoked rise in Orai3 is abolished in Orai1-deficient cardiomyocytes, which the authors read as Orai3/STIM1-calcineurin-NFAT signalling taking over for the missing Orai1
sentence: We observed that the upregulation of Orai3 and Stim1 expression evoked by neurohumoral stress via chronic AngII treatment depends completely on the expression of Orai1.
justification: Expression-level cross-talk inside the ORAI family, after the functional cross-talk recorded in batch 13 (ORAI2/ORAI3 inhibiting ORAI1 in SOCE). Here losing ORAI1 keeps ORAI3 from being induced, so the paralogue is not a free substitute.

mechanism: qPCR on enriched adult cardiomyocytes: the angiotensin-II-evoked induction of Myoz2 (calsarcin-1), a negative regulator of calcineurin, is completely absent without Orai1, and the effect on Rcan1 is strongly reduced, while calcineurin A alpha (Ppp3ca) itself does not move
sentence: Remarkably, we observed that the increased expression of the negative regulator of calcineurin, Myoz2 (Calsarcin-1), in AngII-treated control mice was completely absent in Orai1CM-KO mice; additionally, the effect of AngII observed in controls hearts on Rcan1, another calcineurin regulator, was significantly reduced in Orai1CM-KO hearts without changes in the calcineurin A alpha expression (Ppp3ca) (Figure 5C).
justification: A named brake on calcineurin placed downstream of ORAI1, which matters because the map's calcineurin/NFAT arm is otherwise blocked by generic naming: here the paper names the regulators (Myoz2, Rcan1) and the catalytic subunit (Ppp3ca) separately.

mechanism: same qPCR panel; the angiotensin-II effect on Rcan1, the endogenous calcineurin reporter, was significantly reduced in Orai1CM-KO hearts
sentence: Remarkably, we observed that the increased expression of the negative regulator of calcineurin, Myoz2 (Calsarcin-1), in AngII-treated control mice was completely absent in Orai1CM-KO mice; additionally, the effect of AngII observed in controls hearts on Rcan1, another calcineurin regulator, was significantly reduced in Orai1CM-KO hearts without changes in the calcineurin A alpha expression (Ppp3ca) (Figure 5C).
justification: RCAN1 is the usual read-out of calcineurin activity, so this edge is the closest the map can get to ORAI1 -> calcineurin without the isoform convention the curator has yet to fix on issue #18.

mechanism: soft substrate drove STIM1 aggregation and translocation to colocalize with Orai1 (FRET and confocal), raising cytosolic Ca2+; mu-calpain activation, alpha-spectrin cleavage and apoptosis followed, and STIM1 siRNA blocked it as well as EGTA did
sentence: Chelating extracellular Ca(2+) by EGTA and down-regulated SOC entry by small interfering RNA targeting STIM1 or inhibitors targeting Ca(2+)-binding site of calpain significantly inhibited soft substrate-induced activation of mu-calpain and epithelial cell apoptosis.
justification: A Ca2+-dependent protease as the executioner downstream of STIM1, and a mechanical input (substrate stiffness) upstream of it. The arm ends in apoptosis of normal, not transformed, epithelium - the same STIM1/calpain axis the curator's apoptosis sheet is interested in.

mechanism: STIM1 knockdown in cultured cardiomyocytes blocked the upregulation of TRPC1, abolished SOCE and cut NFAT activation; in STIM1+/- mouse hearts the TRPC1 rise after transverse aortic constriction failed to occur
sentence: Indeed, our in vitro study showed that STIM1 knockdown inhibited the upregulation of TRPC1 and led to the abrogation of SOCE and a robust decrease in the activation of NFAT, which resulted in the inhibition of cardiomyocyte hypertrophy.
justification: Two anchors linked by abundance rather than by contact: STIM1 is needed for TRPC1 to be induced under pressure overload. The map already holds STIM1-TRPC1 binding, so this says the sensor also sets how much channel there is.

mechanism: western blot of TAC-operated hearts: TRPC1, TRPC3, TRPC4 and TRPC6 were all significantly lower in STIM1 haploinsufficient than in wild-type hearts, and the TRPC rise seen after banding did not happen in STIM1+/- mice
sentence: In addition, the upregulation of TRPC1 was inhibited in the hearts of STIM1+/-mice, and the expression of TRPC1, TRPC3, TRPC4 and TRPC6 was significantly lower in STIM1+/-than in WT TAC mice.
justification: The whole TRPC panel, not only the anchor TRPC1, depends on STIM1 for its induction - an argument that STIM1 sets the abundance of its own partner channels as a family.

mechanism: same western blot panel of TAC-operated STIM1+/- versus wild-type hearts
sentence: In addition, the upregulation of TRPC1 was inhibited in the hearts of STIM1+/-mice, and the expression of TRPC1, TRPC3, TRPC4 and TRPC6 was significantly lower in STIM1+/-than in WT TAC mice.
justification: TRPC4 is the partner TRPC1 heteromerizes with in the lung endothelium and in chromaffin cells, so its dependence on STIM1 matters for how the TRPC1 neighbourhood is read.

mechanism: same western blot panel; the effect is on protein level in the hypertrophied heart, not on channel gating
sentence: In addition, the upregulation of TRPC1 was inhibited in the hearts of STIM1+/-mice, and the expression of TRPC1, TRPC3, TRPC4 and TRPC6 was significantly lower in STIM1+/-than in WT TAC mice.
justification: Completes the TRPC panel under STIM1 and sits beside the independent rat evidence that STIM1 gates TRPC6 in podocytes (PMID 31938357), so the map carries both an abundance arm and a gating arm to the same channel.

mechanism: endothelin-1 on cultured rat myocytes raised TRPC1 expression, SOCE and NFAT activation together, and STIM1 knockdown suppressed all three, so the agonist works through the STIM1/TRPC1 pair
sentence: Furthermore, endothelin-1 treatment of cultured rat myocytes enhanced TRPC1 expression, SOCE, and NFAT activation, and the knockdown of STIM1 suppressed these effects, thereby preventing a hypertrophic response.
justification: A hypertrophic agonist upstream of an anchor's abundance. The map has few named inputs on the TRPC1 side, and this one is a receptor ligand with a clear pathological context.

mechanism: immunoprecipitation of endogenous STIM1 from rat liver subcellular fractions followed by LC/MS and confirming western blot; both partners are concentrated in the heavy microsomal (rough ER) fraction, and knocking down or inhibiting Prx-4 left SOCE intact but made it sensitive to H2O2
sentence: Evidence for the interaction of peroxiredoxin-4 with the store-operated calcium channel activator STIM1 in liver cells.
justification: A redox enzyme bound to STIM1 in the rough ER, found on endogenous protein rather than on tagged overexpression. It gives the map a mechanism for the long-noted redox sensitivity of SOCE, and the functional test is informative in the negative: Prx-4 does not set the size of SOCE, it protects it from peroxide.

mechanism: cyclic stretch at 18% or high tidal volume ventilation raised Stim1, Orai1 and PKCalpha protein together in human lung microvascular endothelial cells and in mouse lung; the Orai1 blocker BTP2 prevented the rise and reversed the hyperpermeability and oedema
sentence: When exposed to high tidal volume or large-magnitude CS, Stim1 and Orai1 expression are upregulated, which further activates calcium-sensitive PKCalpha and results in calcium overload, endothelial hyperpermeability, and, finally, lung injury.
justification: A named kinase downstream of both anchors, with the isoform written out (PKCalpha, not "PKC"), in an injury model where the read-out is barrier function. PRKCA is the kind of effector the curator's downstream sheet asks for.

mechanism: same stretch model; BTP2, which inhibits Orai1, lowered Stim1, Orai1 and PKCalpha levels and blocked the Ca2+ influx
sentence: When exposed to high tidal volume or large-magnitude CS, Stim1 and Orai1 expression are upregulated, which further activates calcium-sensitive PKCalpha and results in calcium overload, endothelial hyperpermeability, and, finally, lung injury.
justification: The ORAI1 side of the same kinase arm; the pharmacology (BTP2) acts on ORAI1, so this is the better-supported half of the pair.

mechanism: pull-down assay in diffuse large B cell lymphoma lines: SDF-1-evoked RhoA activation is lost when STIM1 or Orai1 is knocked down, and so is MLC2 phosphorylation and actin polymerization; chelating Ca2+ with EGTA or BAPTA-AM, or blocking the channel with BTP2, did not affect migration at all, so this arm is explicitly Ca2+-independent
sentence: Our results show that RhoA activation by SDF-1 was impaired in cells under-expressing STIM1 or Orai1 suggesting a major role of the RhoA/ROCK pathway in SDF-1-induced B lymphocyte migration (Figure 4B).
justification: A Ca2+-independent function of an anchor, which is exactly what the beyond_calcium flag exists for: the proteins act as scaffolding effectors coupling CXCR4 to RhoA/ROCK, and the in vivo xenograft shows channel blockade cannot substitute for losing the protein. Recording it keeps the map honest that STIM1 and ORAI1 do things that are not calcium entry.

mechanism: same pull-down; Orai1 knockdown impairs RhoA activation, although the authors note STIM1 knockdown inhibits migration more efficiently than Orai1 knockdown and suggest STIM1 is the driver and Orai1 the passenger
sentence: Our results show that RhoA activation by SDF-1 was impaired in cells under-expressing STIM1 or Orai1 suggesting a major role of the RhoA/ROCK pathway in SDF-1-induced B lymphocyte migration (Figure 4B).
justification: The ORAI1 half of the Ca2+-independent arm, kept separately because the paper grades the two contributions differently.

mechanism: SDF-1 (CXCL12) acting through CXCR4 evokes an intracellular Ca2+ rise and an extracellular influx that is attenuated in Orai1- or STIM1-knockdown cells and by CRAC channel blockers
sentence: Using pharmacological and genetic approaches, we revealed that STIM1 and Orai1 were responsible for Ca2+ influx induced by SDF-1.
justification: A chemokine input onto the channel, which the map needs because almost all of its upstream edges are store-depleting drugs rather than physiological agonists. The same paper then shows the migration it drives is not the calcium arm.

mechanism: same experiments; the Ca2+ response to SDF-1 requires STIM1 as well as Orai1
sentence: Using pharmacological and genetic approaches, we revealed that STIM1 and Orai1 were responsible for Ca2+ influx induced by SDF-1.
justification: The sensor side of the same agonist input, recorded so the chemokine does not appear to reach the channel without the sensor.

mechanism: podocytes cultured in serum from db/db rats: STIM1 is up-regulated and gates TRPC6 and Orai1, and STIM1 siRNA changes autophagy and the epithelial-mesenchymal transition markers
sentence: Furthermore, in diabetic nephropathy rats, the up-regulated expression of podocyte STIM1 can activate TRPC6 and Orai1 channels, which results in Ca2+ entry.
justification: A gating arm from STIM1 to TRPC6 in a disease model, next to the abundance arm recorded from PMC5690472. TRPC6 is the podocyte channel of diabetic nephropathy, so this is where the STIM1 axis touches a named human kidney disease.

mechanism: silencing TMEM97 raised, and overexpression lowered, the amount of cholesterol associated with Orai1; the authors read the regulation as TMEM97 lowering plasma membrane cholesterol content and so relieving cholesterol's grip on the channel
sentence: TMEM97 facilitates the activation of SOCE by downregulating the association of cholesterol to Orai1 in MDA-MB-231 cells.
justification: A lipid-transport regulator upstream of ORAI1, acting on the channel's cholesterol environment rather than on its protein partners - a kind of regulation the map had no example of.

mechanism: second read-out of the same manoeuvre: TMEM97 silencing significantly reduced Orai1-STIM1 co-localization, so the cholesterol effect reaches the sensor-channel coupling itself
sentence: Interestingly, silencing of TMEM97 in MDA-MB-231 cells significantly reduced the co-localization of Orai1 with the SOCE regulatory protein STIM1.
justification: Kept as a second evidence row because it is a different measurement (co-localization rather than cholesterol pull-down) and it is the one that ties TMEM97 to the ORAI1-STIM1 interaction the map is built around.

mechanism: histamine-evoked Ca2+ entry in HUVECs is abolished by STIM1 or Orai1 silencing, and the same silencing interrupts calcineurin/NFAT activation and interleukin-8 production
sentence: Interestingly, gene silencing of STIM1 or Orai1 also interrupts the activation of calcineurin/nuclear factor of activated T-cells (NFAT) pathway and the production of interleukin 8 triggered by histamine in HUVECs.
justification: Independent support for the ORAI1 -> IL8 arm recorded in batch 13 from the cystic fibrosis epithelium (PMID 21873556), now in endothelium and with the sensor side added. Two unrelated cell types and two unrelated stimuli converging on the same cytokine is worth having twice.

mechanism: same silencing experiments; histamine is the stimulus and the readout is secreted interleukin-8
sentence: Interestingly, gene silencing of STIM1 or Orai1 also interrupts the activation of calcineurin/nuclear factor of activated T-cells (NFAT) pathway and the production of interleukin 8 triggered by histamine in HUVECs.
justification: A second, independent evidence row on the ORAI1 -> IL8 edge the map already carries, in a different tissue.

mechanism: wild-type Bcl-2 overexpressed in endogenous-Bcl-2-free MDCK cells lowered STIM1, Orai1 and Orai2 protein and reduced SOCE, and also kept STIM1 from translocating into juxta-plasma-membrane puncta after thapsigargin; the three-amino-acid alpha5-helix mutant (144WGR146 to 144AAA146) did the opposite, and the paper's next sentence attributes that increase to "Bcl-2" where the figure shows the mutant
sentence: Western blotting results also demonstrated that WT decreased the level of STIM1, Orai1, and Orai2, resulting in reduction of SOCE.
justification: The canonical anti-apoptotic protein set as an upstream regulator of the anchors' abundance, not only of ER Ca2+ content. It connects the map to the apoptosis axis through expression control, and the BH1 alpha5-helix mutant gives the claim its own internal control.

mechanism: same western blot; wild-type Bcl-2 lowered Orai1 protein and SOCE in MDCK cells, while the alpha5-helix mutant raised Orai1, Orai2, Orai3 and TRPC1 and enhanced SOCE
sentence: Western blotting results also demonstrated that WT decreased the level of STIM1, Orai1, and Orai2, resulting in reduction of SOCE.
justification: The channel side of the Bcl-2 arm. Recorded as a separate row because the two anchors are measured separately on the same blot.

mechanism: same western blot of SOCE-related molecules (STIM1, STIM2, Orai1, Orai2, Orai3, TRPC1)
sentence: Western blotting results also demonstrated that WT decreased the level of STIM1, Orai1, and Orai2, resulting in reduction of SOCE.
justification: ORAI2 is where the map's ORAI paralogue arms are thinnest, and the same regulator moves it in the same direction as ORAI1.

mechanism: lipopolysaccharide on neonatal rat ventricular myocytes raised mitochondrial ROS and redistributed STIM1 onto Orai1 (confocal co-localization plus co-immunoprecipitation); songorine prevented the redistribution, apparently by suppressing ROS
sentence: In cardiomyocytes, lipopolysaccharide (LPS) evoked mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) production and redistributed STIM1 to interact with Orai1 for the formation of calcium release-activated calcium (CRAC) channels, mediating calcium influx, which were prevented by songorine, likely due to ROS suppression.
justification: The anchor-anchor contact driven by an inflammatory stimulus rather than by a store-depleting drug, and shown by co-immunoprecipitation in primary cardiomyocytes. It puts the STIM1-ORAI1 pair inside septic cardiomyopathy, with mitochondrial ROS as the trigger.

mechanism: TRPC1-/- subcutaneous adipose tissue failed to raise adiponectin secretion in response to insulin; TRPC1 loss also reduced SOCE and adipogenesis, and the mice became more adipose later in life
sentence: Summary: TRPC1 modulates Ca2+ entry, which is essential in adipocyte differentiation and adiponectin secretion, through facilitating SNARE complex formation, thereby maintaining metabolic homeostasis.
justification: A secreted hormone as the end of a TRPC1 arm, in a tissue the map does not otherwise reach. It is the clearest whole-animal consequence recorded for TRPC1 so far: losing the channel changes body composition through an adipokine.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation of the SNARE complex: insulin increased the interaction of VAMP2 with syntaxin 1 and SNAP25 in wild-type adipose tissue and not at all in TRPC1-/-; raising cytosolic Ca2+ with thapsigargin increased SNAP25-VAMP2 interaction in wild type only
sentence: To understand the mechanisms of how TRPC1 regulates adipokine secretion, we provide evidence that insulin-stimulated TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ influx is necessary for fusion of VAMP2 with SNAP25 and syntaxin 1, and is thus necessary for the secretion of adipokines.
justification: The machinery between the channel and the hormone, named protein by protein. The map's effector ends are usually transcription factors; this is an exocytosis arm, and the Ca2+ dependence is tested directly with thapsigargin.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitations; the SNAP25-VAMP2 interaction responds to insulin and to raised cytosolic Ca2+ in wild-type tissue and not in TRPC1-/-, while SKF-96365 pretreatment separates the syntaxin-1 and SNAP25 arms
sentence: To understand the mechanisms of how TRPC1 regulates adipokine secretion, we provide evidence that insulin-stimulated TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ influx is necessary for fusion of VAMP2 with SNAP25 and syntaxin 1, and is thus necessary for the secretion of adipokines.
justification: The second named SNARE under TRPC1. "Syntaxin 1" is left out of the map on purpose: the paper does not say STX1A or STX1B, and that is the generic-name convention waiting on issue #18.

mechanism: STIM1 knock-out mouse embryonic fibroblasts have tubular, metabolically more active mitochondria with a higher Ca2+ concentration and constitutive oxidative stress; NRF2 nuclear translocation is increased, with increased phosphorylation of eIF2alpha and PERK, and the phenotype is rescued by reconstituting STIM1
sentence: STIM1 knock-out mitochondria are tubular, have a higher Ca(2+) concentration, and are metabolically more active, resulting in constitutive oxidative stress causing increased nuclear translocation of the antioxidant transcription factor NRF2 triggered by increased phosphorylation of the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha and the protein kinase-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase PERK.
justification: An arm from STIM1 to the antioxidant response, with the sign read off a knock-out: losing STIM1 drives NRF2 into the nucleus, so STIM1 restrains it. It also gives the map a second, independent reason to care about the STIM1-mitochondria link besides shape and bioenergetics.

mechanism: same knock-out fibroblasts; PERK and eIF2alpha phosphorylation rise without STIM1, placing the ER stress branch between the mitochondrial phenotype and NRF2
sentence: STIM1 knock-out mitochondria are tubular, have a higher Ca(2+) concentration, and are metabolically more active, resulting in constitutive oxidative stress causing increased nuclear translocation of the antioxidant transcription factor NRF2 triggered by increased phosphorylation of the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha and the protein kinase-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase PERK.
justification: PERK is the named ER stress kinase of this arm, and the map's ER stress neighbourhood (ATF6, XBP1 on the STING side) has nothing linking it to STIM1 yet.

mechanism: house dust mite extract activates store-operated channels and the serine protease allergen Der p3 is the major activator of Orai1; the extract stimulates PAR2 as well as PAR4, but the Ca2+ influx tracks the PAR4 pathway, and sub-maximal inhibition of both Der p3 and Orai1 together suppresses mast cell activation
sentence: Activation of channel pore-forming Orai1 subunits by mite extract requires gating by STIM1 proteins. Although mite extract stimulates both protease-activated receptor type 2 (PAR2) and PAR4 receptors, Ca2+ influx is more tightly coupled to the PAR4 pathway.
justification: A receptor input onto ORAI1 from an allergen protease, with the receptor isoform named (PAR4, not "PARs") and discriminated against PAR2 by experiment. The therapeutic read-out - inhibiting Der p3 and ORAI1 together - is the sort of combination the curator's effector sheet is after.

mechanism: affinity purification of Orai1 from HeLa cells stably expressing Orai1 and STIM1 identified CRACR2A (EFCAB4B) by mass spectrometry; GST pulldown of recombinant proteins shows a direct interaction with the Orai1 N terminus (residues 64-93) that is lost in 2 mM Ca2+ and insensitive to Ca2+ in the EF-hand mutant, and the K85A/K87A double mutant of Orai1 loses the binding
sentence: We show that CRACR2A directly interacts with Orai1 and STIM1, forming a ternary complex that dissociates at elevated Ca2+ concentrations.
justification: The lead behind Bhardwaj 2013's passing mention, chased to its primary paper. A cytosolic Ca2+ sensor that holds the ORAI1-STIM1 complex together and lets go when Ca2+ rises is a third member of the map's central pair, and the Ca2+-dependence makes it a feedback element rather than a static scaffold.

mechanism: GST fusions of the STIM1 cytoplasmic domain: full-length CRACR2A binds the coiled-coil and PEST domains, with binding reduced in Ca2+, while the S/T-rich region that binds Orai1 does not bind CRACR2A
sentence: Together these data suggest that CRACR2A binds to both Orai1 and STIM1 in a Ca2+-sensitive manner.
justification: The second leg of the ternary complex, mapped to named STIM1 domains that are distinct from the SOAR/CAD region used for ORAI1. It explains how one protein can bridge the pair instead of competing with it.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation with Orai2 and Orai3; the Orai1 residues 64-93 that carry the interaction are conserved across the family
sentence: CRACR2A co-immunoprecipitated with Orai2 and Orai3 suggesting a conserved binding mechanism with all the Orai proteins (Fig. 2c).
justification: A regulator shared by the whole ORAI family, which matters now that the map carries ORAI2 and ORAI3 as separate actors with their own signs on SOCE.

mechanism: same co-immunoprecipitation
sentence: CRACR2A co-immunoprecipitated with Orai2 and Orai3 suggesting a conserved binding mechanism with all the Orai proteins (Fig. 2c).
justification: Completes the ORAI family binding, beside the conflicting ORAI3 -> ORAI1 signs the map already shows.

mechanism: siRNA depletion of CRACR2A cut SOCE by 50% in Jurkat T cells and impaired the clustering of both Orai1 and STIM1 (TIRF microscopy); co-expression with Orai1 in Orai1-null MEFs more than doubled the peak [Ca2+]i, and co-expression rescued the clustering-deficient Orai1 K85A/K87A mutant, whereas CRACR2B had only a marginal effect
sentence: These data suggest a specific role of CRACR2A in enhancement of Orai1-mediated SOCE that is distinct from CRACR2B.
justification: The functional counterpart of the binding: the scaffold is needed for the anchors to cluster at ER-PM junctions, so it is a positive regulator of SOCE and not merely a passenger in the complex.

mechanism: the paralogue CRACR2B (EFCAB4A) is the dominant one in HEK293 cells, where its depletion cuts SOCE more than CRACR2A depletion does, and re-expression of either protein restores SOCE in CRACR2B-depleted cells; the two are functionally redundant but differently expressed, CRACR2A being abundant in spleen, thymus and T cells
sentence: Surprisingly, in HEK293 cells, depletion of CRACR2B had a stronger effect on SOCE than that of CRACR2A (Fig. 3a, bottom).
justification: The same regulatory position filled by a different paralogue depending on cell type - the pattern the map keeps running into (ORAI1/2/3, STIM1/2, IP3R1/2/3) and an argument for naming isoforms rather than families.
